frame: the fight range (brief 029): integer centimetres, x along the range from the cell's end, y across; the floor x 0–45 m, y 0–40 m; the wings x 49–61 m. No clock: the range has no schedule (the schedule below is the format's, never read).

grid.src: tools/sim/range.ts: the floor 45 × 40 m, a cell free when its centre is 65 cm clear of the floor's edge and of every piece; the wings x 49–61 m all free and unreachable from the floor
